objective: Auditar sin modificar nada el descuadre reportado en Preview para ORIGEN y ESTELAR del 2026-10-01 al 2026-10-15 despues del rollback. Comparar acumulado de KPI base, Runtime y detalle historico, y mostrar diferencias por dia para localizar exactamente donde se desalinearon. No modificar datos, codigo, vistas, sincronizadores ni Produccion.

queries.name: origen_totales_capas
queries.sql: SELECT 'BASE' AS capa,CAST(SUM(ventas_total) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas,SUM(tickets_total) AS tickets,SUM(pax_total) AS pax FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-15' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_demo,0)=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'RUNTIME',CAST(SUM(ventas_total) AS decimal(18,2)),SUM(tickets_total),SUM(pax_total) FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-15'

queries.name: origen_detalle_total
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(x.venta_ticket) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_detalle,COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle,SUM(x.pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle FROM (SELECT numero_ticket,fecha_operacion,SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(importe_neto,0) ELSE 0 END) AS venta_ticket,MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(pax,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-15' GROUP BY numero_ticket,fecha_operacion) x

queries.name: origen_por_dia
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(b.fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha,CAST(b.ventas_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS base_ventas,CAST(r.ventas_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS runtime_ventas,b.tickets_total AS base_tickets,r.tickets_total AS runtime_tickets,b.pax_total AS base_pax,r.pax_total AS runtime_pax FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 b LEFT JOIN dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime r ON r.unidad_negocio_pk=b.unidad_negocio_pk AND r.sucursal_id=b.sucursal_id AND r.fecha_operacion=b.fecha_operacion WHERE b.unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND b.fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-15' AND ISNULL(b.activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(b.es_demo,0)=0 ORDER BY b.fecha_operacion

queries.name: estelar_totales_capas
queries.sql: SELECT 'BASE' AS capa,CAST(SUM(ventas_total) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas,SUM(tickets_total) AS tickets,SUM(pax_total) AS pax FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-15' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_demo,0)=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'RUNTIME',CAST(SUM(ventas_total) AS decimal(18,2)),SUM(tickets_total),SUM(pax_total) FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-15'

queries.name: estelar_detalle_total
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(x.venta_ticket) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_detalle,COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle,SUM(x.pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle FROM (SELECT numero_ticket,fecha_operacion,SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(importe_neto,0) ELSE 0 END) AS venta_ticket,MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(pax,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-15' GROUP BY numero_ticket,fecha_operacion) x
